title: Lidar Point Cloud Generator
source_docs: Automated Driving Toolbox/Driving Scenario and Sensor Modeling/Lidar_Point_Cloud_Generator.md
text: Generate lidar point cloud data for driving scenario or RoadRunner Scenario, 2 inputs, 1 output; {Unique identifier of sensor} sets the unique sensor identifier, {Required interval between sensor updates (s)} sets the required time interval between sensor, {Sensor’s (x,y) position (m)} sets the location of center of lidar sensor, {Sensor’s height (m)} sets the height of lidar sensor, {Yaw angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)} sets the yaw angle of lidar sensor, {Pitch angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)} sets the pitch angle of lidar sensor, {Roll angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)} sets the roll angle of lidar sensor, {Coordinate system used to report point cloud} sets the coordinate system of reported detections Ego, {Include ego vehicle in generated point cloud} sets the include ego vehicle in point cloud, {ActorID of ego vehicle} sets the actorID value of ego vehicle, {Include roads in generated point cloud} sets the include roads in point cloud, {Source of actor profiles}, {MATLAB or model workspace variable name} sets the variable name of actor profiles, {Maximum detection range (m)}, {Range accuracy (m)} sets the accuracy of range measurements, {Azimuthal resolution of lidar (deg)} sets the azimuthal resolution of lidar sensor, {Elevation resolution of lidar (deg)} sets the elevation resolution of lidar sensor, {Azimuthal limits of lidar (deg)} sets the azimuthal limits of lidar sensor, {Elevation limits of lidar (deg)} sets the elevation limits of lidar sensor and {Add noise to measurements}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Unique identifier of sensor
params.values: Unique sensor identifier 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Sensor’s (x,y) position (m)
params.values: Location of center of lidar sensor [1.5 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-2 vector

params.name: Sensor’s height (m)

params.name: Yaw angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)
params.values: Yaw angle of lidar sensor 0 (default) | real-valued scalar

params.name: Pitch angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)
params.values: Pitch angle of lidar sensor 0 (default) | real-valued scalar

params.name: Roll angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)
params.values: Roll angle of lidar sensor 0 (default) | real-valued scalar

params.values: Coordinate system of reported detections Ego Cartesian (default) | Sensor Cartesian

params.name: Include ego vehicle in generated point cloud

params.name: Include roads in generated point cloud
